pages.text: There are two ways to obtain Bloodweave: one is to alter Cobwebs, and the other is to harvest it whenever a $(l:offsprings/weaver)$(c)$(o)Weaver$() creates one through killing a creature. Bloodweave connects with itself, forming webs of memories, not unlike a neural system. When pushed By a Piston, the entire web will move. It can also be used to create living mechanisms.
